FROM feat/1168-node-host-tools TO development
Closes #1168

## Stories

- [x] US-001: Install root-level host tools
- [x] US-005: Pin the workspace ref
- [x] US-002: Add the code-server tool
- [x] US-003: Add the docker tool
- [x] US-004: Add the desktop tool
- [x] US-006: Document and release

## What the issue asked for

Give AGRO the host tools that a dedicated VM node needs, so that `mifunedev/agro-console` can build every node from one pinned AGRO release: root-level installs through `sudo`, code-server, Docker Engine, an XFCE desktop over RDP through Tailscale, and a workspace clone pinned to a release tag. Release the result as 0.15.0.

## What was built

- A catalog entry can set `hostInstallUser: "root"`. For a non-root user, `agro tool install <id> --host` first runs `sudo -n true`. If that fails, it exits 1 and changes nothing. Otherwise it runs the installer as `sudo -n -- <script>`. `agro tool list` marks these tools `(root)`.
- `agro workspace create [<name>] --ref <ref>` clones `mifunedev/agro` at a branch or tag. A missing ref exits 1, names the ref, and removes the directory it created.
- `agro tool install code-server --host` installs code-server 4.129.0 (SHA-256 checked for amd64 and arm64) to `~/.local/lib/code-server-4.129.0` and links `~/.local/bin/code-server`.
- `agro tool install docker-engine --host` installs Docker Engine, the CLI, containerd, buildx, and compose from Docker's Ubuntu repository. It checks the key fingerprint, adds the invoking user to `docker`, and enables the service. Inside a sandbox the command refuses and names `access.dockerSocket`.
- `agro tool install desktop --host` installs system Tailscale from Tailscale's apt repository (key fingerprint checked), XFCE, and XRDP. An nftables table allows TCP 3389 only on `lo` and `tailscale0`. The command changes no SSH rule, sets no password, and prints `sudo tailscale up` and `sudo passwd <user>`.
- Docs, the changelog (`## [0.15.0]`), and the version bump to 0.15.0.

## Where it diverged

- **US-003:** the tool id is `docker-engine`, not `docker`, because the runtime catalog owns `docker` (probe `tool-catalog-boundary`).
- **US-004 AC2:** the plan required an existing `agro tool install tailscale --host`. That tool installs a user binary with no `tailscaled` service, so `sudo tailscale up` and `tailscale0` would not exist on a VM. The desktop tool installs system Tailscale itself.
- **US-002 AC6:** `agro tool uninstall` has no `--host` flag. It targets the host when no sandbox is reachable. The uninstall ran in that mode.
- **Probes:** `harness-one-door` and `agent-browser-host-boundary` now check root-level tools with their own rule (host-only, host-capable, installed only through the `sudo -n` path). The rules for user-level tools are unchanged. Fault injection on five mutations made the probes fail as expected.

## What remains unverified

- The Docker, desktop, and code-server installs have not run on a real Ubuntu 24.04 VM. The mifunedev/agro-console#168 node validation (US-007) runs them. See `## Host install evidence`.
- The desktop nftables file has not been syntax-checked with `nft` (not installed in the sandbox).
- Publication of 0.15.0 happens after the merge.

## Lessons

- The eval probes allowed only user-level host installs. Fixed in this PR.
- The `tailscale` tool has no `tailscaled` service, so the desktop tool installs system Tailscale. Fixed in this PR.
- A host tool install needs an existing workspace. Fixed in this PR (docs; the agro-console bootstrap creates the workspace first).
- A root-level host tool gets a user-level receipt, and uninstall refuses it. Proposed issue, pending operator approval.
- The public docs in `mifunedev/agro-web` do not name the new tools. Proposed issue, pending operator approval.
- The host installs have not run on a real VM. Dropped from this PR; mifunedev/agro-console#168 US-007 runs them.
